title: Wildcard firstMatching scan materializes every matched subject into a slice and rescans it per message

source.license_note: Real upstream nats optimization PR #6908; measured-speedup task.

task.summary: Speed up msgBlock.firstMatching for wildcard filters by not materializing a subs []string of every matching subject and not rescanning it for each scanned message.
task.instructions: Optimize the server package for speed WITHOUT changing behavior. The benchmark Benchmark_FileStoreLoadNextMsgVerySparseMsgsInBetweenWithWildcard measures it; existing tests must still pass.
task.acceptance_notes: Behavior preserved (go test passes); higher measured speedup is better. Do NOT edit any *_test.go.

code_fault.description: firstMatching builds a subs []string of all matched subjects (copying each via string(bsubj)) and loops it per scanned message, costing O(subs) work and allocations on sparse wildcard scans.

ops_fault.description: Profiling shows hot path and excessive allocations in msgBlock.firstMatching wildcard branch building and rescanning a per-subject slice.
repair_keywords: fold recalc and fseq into fss.Match callback

visible_context.issue_text: Loading the next message for a wildcard filter over a block with very sparse messages is slow and allocation-heavy; the more distinct matching subjects a block tracks, the worse each LoadNextMsg gets.
error_logs: pprof: 71% cum in server.(*msgBlock).firstMatching; alloc_objects dominated by string(bsubj) in fss.Match callback; Benchmark_FileStoreLoadNextMsgVerySparseMsgsInBetweenWithWildcard ~ high ns/op and B/op
visible_context.notes: Real upstream optimization; profiling diagnosis injected as upstream context.
